content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure grow muscle about equally well from roughly 5 to 30 reps. Light weights work if the sets are hard, and heavy weights work too.

Heavy work still matters for your goal, though. A 100 kg bench is a strength target, and strength is specific to the load. So keep most of your chest work in the 6-12 rep range for growth. Add some heavy sets of 3-5 on bench to practice the skill of lifting big weights. 💪
